name: sagemaker-featurestore-runtime
description: Contains all data plane API operations and data types for the Amazon SageMaker Feature Store.

subcommands.name: batch-get-record
subcommands.description: Retrieves a batch of Records from a FeatureGroup

options.name: --identifiers
options.description: A list containing the name or Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the FeatureGroup, the list of names of Features to be retrieved, and the corresponding RecordIdentifier values as strings

options.name: --expiration-time-response
options.description: Parameter to request ExpiresAt in response.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: delete-record
subcommands.description: Deletes a Record from a FeatureGroup in the OnlineStore.

options.name: --feature-group-name
options.description: The name or Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the feature group to delete the record from

options.name: --record-identifier-value-as-string
options.description: The value for the RecordIdentifier that uniquely identifies the record, in string format

options.name: --event-time
options.description: Timestamp indicating when the deletion event occurred.

options.name: --target-stores
options.description: A list of stores from which you're deleting the record.

options.name: --deletion-mode
options.description: The name of the deletion mode for deleting the record.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: get-record
subcommands.description: Use for OnlineStore serving from a FeatureStore.

options.name: --feature-group-name
options.description: The name or Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the feature group from which you want to retrieve a record

options.name: --record-identifier-value-as-string
options.description: The value that corresponds to RecordIdentifier type and uniquely identifies the record in the FeatureGroup

options.name: --feature-names
options.description: List of names of Features to be retrieved.

options.name: --expiration-time-response
options.description: Parameter to request ExpiresAt in response.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: put-record
subcommands.description: The PutRecord API is used to ingest a list of Records into your feature group.

options.name: --feature-group-name
options.description: The name or Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the feature group that you want to insert the record into

options.name: --record
options.description: List of FeatureValues to be inserted.

options.name: --target-stores
options.description: A list of stores to which you're adding the record.

options.name: --ttl-duration
options.description: Time to live duration, where the record is hard deleted after the expiration time is reached; ExpiresAt = EventTime + TtlDuration.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
